RESPONSE_CONTROLS.DEFAULT_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Unless overridden below, new posts automatically inherit:
RESPONSE_CONTROLS.EMPTY_DESC: No posts matching "{query}" were found. Try modifying your search or filter.
RESPONSE_CONTROLS.DM_CONTROLS_DESC: Configure auto-response behavior for incoming direct messages, new conversations, and story mentions.
RESPONSE_CONTROLS.COMMENTS_AUTO_REPLY_DESC: Automatically respond to public comments on this post
RESPONSE_CONTROLS.DM_INQUIRIES_DESC: Automatically send private DMs when triggered

CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.TITLE: Create Automation
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.SUBTITLE: Set up your automation rule in a few simple steps.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.POST_ID_HELPER: The numeric media ID of the post to watch for comments.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.KEYWORDS_HELPER: The comment must match this keyword to trigger the automation.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.MATCH_CONTAINS_DESC: Trigger if the comment contains the keyword.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.MATCH_EXACT_DESC: Trigger only if the comment is exactly the keyword.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.PUBLIC_REPLIES_PLACEHOLDER:
One reply per line, e.g.
Thanks! Check your DMs 🙌
Sent you the details!
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.PUBLIC_REPLIES_HELPER: One reply per line — we rotate through them so replies don't look identical.
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Type the direct message to send...
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.SUMMARY_RESPONSE: {count} public replies configured, plus a DM
CREATE_AUTOMATION_MODAL.ENABLE_HELPER: Turn this rule on immediately after saving.

CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.TITLE: New Template
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.HEADING: Let's start with the basics
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.SUBHEADING: Give your template a name and choose its type.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_DESC: Use this template to reply to incoming messages or DMs.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.COMMENT_TEMPLATE_DESC: Use this template to reply to comments on your posts.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.NAME_HELPER: Give your template a clear and recognizable name.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: e.g., Send a warm welcome message to new followers or new contacts.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.DESCRIPTION_HELPER: Helps you and your team understand when to use this template.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.LANGUAGE_HELPER: This helps us personalize variables and suggestions.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.PREVIEW_SUBTITLE: This is how your template will appear.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.PREVIEW_BODY: Thanks for reaching out to us. We're here to help! What can we do for you today?
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.ABOUT_VARIABLES_DESC: Use variables to automatically personalize your messages.
CREATE_TEMPLATE_WIZARD.SAVE_TIME_DESC: Use templates in your automations to maintain consistency and save time.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure global settings for your autoresponder.

GENERAL.GLOBAL_AUTOMATION_DESC: Enable or disable all autoresponder automations across your workspace.
GENERAL.DEFAULT_RESPONSE_SETTINGS_DESC: Set default behavior for new automations.
GENERAL.DUPLICATE_PREVENTION_DESC: Avoid sending the same automated reply twice.
GENERAL.AUTO_ASSIGNMENT_DESC: Automatically assign conversations touched by automations.
GENERAL.TAGS_LABELS_DESC: Automatically tag conversations handled by automations.
GENERAL.AUTOMATION_SAFETY_DESC: Relay automatically applies limits and delays to prevent spammy behavior across every automation.
GENERAL.TIP_1: Start with a small set of high-intent keywords before expanding.
GENERAL.TIP_2: Use response delays to keep replies feeling natural.
GENERAL.TIP_3: Review your Activity log weekly to catch failed automations early.

RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.TYPING_INDICATOR_DESC: Display a typing indicator before sending automated replies.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.RANDOM_DELAY_DESC: Add a random delay between replies to feel more human.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.READ_INBOUND_DESC: Mark the triggering message as read before responding.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.SPLIT_LONG_MESSAGES_DESC: Break long responses into multiple shorter messages.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.RICH_PREVIEWS_DESC: Show a rich preview card when a response includes a link.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.ABOUT_DESC: These settings control how automations sound and feel when replying to customers.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.PRACTICE_1: Keep responses under 3 short sentences when possible.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.PRACTICE_2: Enable a small random delay to avoid feeling robotic.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.PRACTICE_3: Always leave an escape hatch to reach a human agent.
RESPONSE_BEHAVIOR.PREVIEW_BODY: Hi there! Thanks for reaching out — we'll get back to you shortly.

SAFETY_LIMITS.SAFE_MODE_DESC: Automatically throttle automations that approach platform rate limits.
SAFETY_LIMITS.RESPECT_LIMITS_DESC: Automatically pause automations that would exceed platform limits.
SAFETY_LIMITS.PREVENT_DUPLICATES_DESC: Never send the same automated reply to the same contact twice.
SAFETY_LIMITS.CHECK_SIMILAR_DESC: Use fuzzy matching to catch near-duplicate replies.
SAFETY_LIMITS.ALLOW_ALL_CHANNELS_DESC: Turn off to restrict automations to explicitly approved channels.
SAFETY_LIMITS.KEYWORD_FILTERING_DESC: Block automations from replying to messages containing flagged keywords.
SAFETY_LIMITS.AUTO_FLAG_DESC: Flag unusual automation activity for manual review.
SAFETY_LIMITS.BLOCK_UNKNOWN_DESC: Skip automations for contacts with no prior interaction history.
SAFETY_LIMITS.WHY_MATTERS_DESC: Platforms like Instagram and WhatsApp enforce strict rate limits. These settings help keep your account in good standing.
SAFETY_LIMITS.IMPORTANT_ALERT: Exceeding platform rate limits can result in temporary automation restrictions.

BUSINESS_HOURS.BUSINESS_HOURS_DESC: Automations can behave differently inside and outside your business hours.
BUSINESS_HOURS.SEND_AWAY_MESSAGE_DESC: Automatically reply with a message letting customers know you're away.
BUSINESS_HOURS.PAUSE_AUTOMATION_DESC: Stop all automated responses outside business hours.
BUSINESS_HOURS.ROUTE_TO_TEAM_DESC: Assign incoming conversations to an on-call agent instead.
BUSINESS_HOURS.ABOUT_DESC: Business hours let your automations respond differently when your team is offline.

CHANNELS.NO_CHANNELS_CONNECTED: You haven't connected any channels yet.
CHANNELS.ABOUT_DESC: Connect the channels you want autoresponder automations to run on.

NOTIFICATIONS.ENABLE_QUIET_HOURS_DESC: Pause non-critical notifications during quiet hours.
NOTIFICATIONS.DAILY_DIGEST_DESC: Get a daily summary of automation activity by email.
NOTIFICATIONS.ABOUT_DESC: Choose how you want to be notified about automation activity.

ADVANCED.RETRY_FAILED_DESC: Automatically retry an automation action if it fails.
ADVANCED.STORE_HISTORY_DESC: Keep a copy of automated conversations for reporting.
ADVANCED.API_ACCESS_DESC: Allow external services to trigger automations via the API.
ADVANCED.MAINTENANCE_MODE_DESC: Temporarily pause all automations for maintenance.
ADVANCED.ABOUT_DESC: These settings control the underlying automation engine — change with care.
